description: Tables created by runtime DDL (server/, migrations/) but not declared in shared/schema. drizzle-kit cannot manage them and drizzle.config.ts filters them out of push. This list may only shrink: declare a table in shared/schema, then remove it here. tests/runtime-only-tables-ratchet.test.ts enforces it. Recorded on 2026-10-30 while restoring main certification: the Production Target Bonuses programme (#2612 through #2647), the extra expected loading lines and the destination normalization audit landed on main creating these 17 tables only through runtime DDL. They are drift to repay, not an exemption: declaring each in shared/schema with the same columns, keys and indexes as its ensure* DDL removes it from this list.
